title: Charging Issues
text: Charging Issues. I've been waiting awhile to review this in hopes that my issue would resolve itself. It hasn't. I love this vacuum except for the fact that sometimes it doesn't charge correctly. I have a small house with 98% hard surface floors and I use this everyday at about the same time to clean up cat litter sprinkles and other light debris. Some days I can do the whole house, no problems. Then randomly I will get one room done and it will stop and need to be charged.  Kind of a bummer. I had a Bissel Bolt Pet, that was terrific until it finally died after years of use. Never had a charging problem with that and it cost half as much.
